nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Wait. Something here is not quite right.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The notices are pinned at the same height except one. That one sits higher, and the tape behind it is clean where the old tape was. Someone moved it up to be read.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: A board with a few sheets pinned to it. What else is there to see?

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You read the top two: a room wanted, a piano for sale. The third has been turned face-in. It has not been taken down.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The yard is long and fairly narrow. The path comes in at one corner.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: There is a seam down the middle of the concrete, where two pours meet. It runs all the way across. The main gate, though, is at the short end.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: A yard. Two hoops, a shed, a bench.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You have seen a yard like this before. Or perhaps schoolyards just tend to look alike.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: Hold on. Look at where the hoop's pole is set.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The concrete around the pole is newer than the rest of the yard. There are old bolt holes in the wall too, filled in and painted over. The hoop must have stood somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: voice_orientation
nodes.text: The rim looks to be at an ordinary height.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You couldn't say how high a hoop is meant to be. But the concrete around the base is a different colour, and the net looks newer than the rim.
